children: M Evo Global Acquisition reported net income in the third quarter, compared with a loss in the prior-year inception period. Interest earned on Trust Account investments more than offset general and administrative costs; the company said it has not begun operations and expects no operating revenue before completing a business combination.
: Investments totaled $307.1M at September 30, 2026, including $7.1M of interest income for the nine months.
: The company continued identifying a target and expects to use substantially all Trust Account funds toward a business combination.
: Cash outside the Trust Account was $877,481 at September 30; management said projected liquidity needs raise substantial doubt about going concern.
: Ashley Zumwalt-Forbes became CEO and board chair on September 9, succeeding Stephen M. Silver.
